  • Method Details

    • title

      public AlertDialog.Builder title(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component title)
      Title text shown at the top of the dialog. Required.

    • body

      public AlertDialog.Builder body(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component body)
      Body text shown below the title. Required.

      Single-line in v1. For multi-line bodies, compose the Panel manually — see ConfirmDialog class javadoc and DIALOGS.md §5.

    • onAcknowledge

      public AlertDialog.Builder onAcknowledge(Runnable onAcknowledge)
      Fired when the user clicks the Acknowledge button. Required.

      The library does not auto-dismiss the dialog — consumer's callback is responsible for mutating their visibility state to close the dialog (typically setting their dialogOpen boolean to false).

    • acknowledgeLabel

      public AlertDialog.Builder acknowledgeLabel(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component label)
      Override the Acknowledge button label. Default: "OK".

    • id

      public AlertDialog.Builder id(String id)
      Override the Panel's id. Default: auto-generated unique id of the form "alert-dialog-N". Specify explicitly when registering multiple alert dialogs to ensure stable IDs.

    • build

      public Panel build()
      Construct the configured dialog Panel. Modal-by-default via Panel.modal() (sets opaque + dimsBehind + tracksAsModal); starts hidden (visibility set via Panel.showWhen(BooleanSupplier)).
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if any required field (title, body, onAcknowledge) is unset
